title: no3in-archive: reproducible data and verification for the no-three-in-line census
description: Code and data archive accompanying the paper 'Cycle structure and the Hamming geometry of no-three-in-line solutions'. Pins the exact snapshot of Flammenkamp's no-three-in-line database (revision 2026-08-19, SHA-256 557645ec311e43a619f8926e52f99fb03ddbe0d65e05a3acd99399f3b7bd9023), recomputes every [DB-Exh] claim with two independent code paths, and provides derived tables (CSV/JSON), a one-command reproduction script, machine-readable verification outputs, and Section 8 solver-study materials with explicit exhaustive/incomplete run statuses. The raw database itself is not redistributed (no explicit licence); the download recipe and digest pin are included instead. Python 3.9+, standard library only for the main pipeline.
